tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App and page background. The film room: near-black with a cool turf tint, never pure #000.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, tag form, play list rail.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Inputs, table header rows, hovered rows, chip backgrounds.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Pressed / selected neutral states, kbd keycaps.

tokens.name: video-well
tokens.usage: Letterbox behind every video player. Stays dark in both themes so footage reads the same.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows, panel edges, default input borders.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders on hover, dividers that must survive projection; 3:1 against surface-1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg and surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, table meta. Passes 4.5:1 on surface-1 and surface-2 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled text, timestamps at 12px+. Only for non-essential text (≈4.5:1 on bg, lower on surface-2).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Down-marker orange. Primary actions, the current play, selection, focus fill. The ONE token a team color replaces.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills. Recomputed when a team color is applied (black or white, whichever passes 4.5:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for the selected play row and active filter chips.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent-colored text on bg/surfaces (links, active tab labels).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline on every focusable element. Keyboard-first product: never suppressed.

tokens.name: play-run
tokens.usage: Run plays in chips, bars and charts. Light green, lighter than pass so the pair also splits by lightness.

tokens.name: play-pass
tokens.usage: Pass plays. Mid blue.

tokens.name: play-rpo
tokens.usage: RPO plays. Violet.

tokens.name: play-screen
tokens.usage: Screens / quick game to the perimeter. Teal.

tokens.name: play-special
tokens.usage: Special teams. Gold.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive result, processed, availability OK, gain of yards.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Suggested (unconfirmed) tags, YouTube source at risk, processing.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, turnovers, negative plays, destructive actions.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Turf green for field-position strips and the cover. Never a page background.

tokens.name: field-line
tokens.usage: Yard lines and hash marks drawn on field.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Modal scrim. Never over a YouTube player area.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Page titles in the app, opponent name on the print sheet.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Section titles, panel headers on report pages.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big percentages and counts in tendency tiles. Tabular figures.

styles.name: down-distance
styles.usage: Down & distance badge in the breakdown screen and play list.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel and card headings in the app.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Paste a YouTube link or import from Drive.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Table cells, play list meta, dense panels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels and column headers. Sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: marketing-lead
styles.sample: Phone video from the stands is enough.

styles.name: timecode
styles.usage: Clip start/end, video timecodes, hotkey legends.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside compact controls, play row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Form field gaps, list item padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, mobile side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panels on the breakdown screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing in reports and settings.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Marketing section rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, kbd caps, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, play rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, modals, video frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Filter pills, avatars, status dots.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, command palette, hotkey cheat sheet. Panels use borders, not shadows.
